recognize_zh: 抹片（A）中是大型、細胞質布滿大小不一泡泡狀空泡、細胞核圓且常為雙核的上皮樣細胞，切片（B、C）呈淡染、泡狀細胞位於黏液樣基質中，這種「含空泡細胞」（physaliphorous cell）是脊索瘤（chordoma）的特徵，標題「chord」即暗示此診斷。
features: Panel A (aspirate smear): large cohesive cells with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm containing multiple variably sized clear vacuoles (physaliphorous/bubbly cells)
Round, eccentric nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; frequent binucleate forms and small nucleoli
Panel B (core biopsy, low power): marrow spaces between trabeculae replaced by a pale, lobulated, hypocellular tumor
Panel C: cords and single vacuolated cells embedded in a pale myxoid/chondroid-like matrix
Panels D/E: diffuse cytoplasmic and nuclear (D) and membranous (E) immunohistochemical positivity; antigens not labeled in figure
Panel F: strong magenta staining of tumor cells and matrix, consistent with PAS or mucin-type histochemical stain
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of large non-hematopoietic cells with abundant pale cytoplasm filled with multiple clear vacuoles of varying sizes and round eccentric nuclei, including binucleate forms. The core biopsy shows intertrabecular spaces replaced by a pale, lobulated tumor composed of cords and single vacuolated cells in a myxoid matrix. Immunostains show diffuse cytoplasmic/nuclear and membranous positivity in the tumor cells (antigens not labeled), and a histochemical stain highlights the cells and matrix in magenta. Findings are suggestive of metastatic chordoma involving the marrow; brachyury (TBXT), cytokeratin and S100 immunostains confirm this diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring cell or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells have a single mucin vacuole indenting the nucleus or clear glycogenated cytoplasm without myxoid matrix, and are brachyury negative.
Chondrosarcoma cells sit in lacunae within hyaline/chondroid matrix and are S100 positive but cytokeratin and brachyury negative.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary crumpled-tissue-paper cytoplasm and foamy histiocytes have fine uniform vacuoles, both CD68 positive and non-cohesive.
Gelatinous transformation shows acellular pale extracellular material with hypoplastic marrow rather than cohesive atypical vacuolated tumor cells.
